import json
from pathlib import Path
chemin = Path("profil.json")
chemin.write_text(json.dumps({"nom": "Awa"}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.loads(chemin.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["nom"])
